summary: Prompt-only RealVisXL did not understand the Stegosaurus plate/thagomizer gate even with a strict trigger and negative prompt. The four smoke outputs drifted into theropod or generic dinosaur body plans, so none should enter the stegosaur_plates_tailspikes LoRA seed set.
primaryRejectReasons: dorsal plates are weak, small, spiny, or missing instead of broad separated Stegosaurus plates
body plans drift toward theropod or generic bipedal dinosaurs
four-spike thagomizer is missing or not countable
quadrupedal Stegosaurus silhouette is not reliable
plate rows do not show clear broad alternating bony plates with visible gaps
nextRoute: Do not use prompt-only RealVisXL generations as training images for this dataset. Expand from reviewed internal plate/thagomizer guides and feature-specific candidates, or test an Illustrious-compatible branch with the public Stegosaurus LoRA only as a separate comparison route.
